content: The TCT 2008 schedule outlines a series of events, meetings, and interviews designed to facilitate discussions on cutting-edge interventional cardiology topics. Below is a detailed breakdown of the schedule and associated activities: General Information: Press conferences for late-breaking trials are scheduled on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, starting at approximately 12:15 or 12:30 PM. After these sessions, presenters and moderators will be escorted to the TCT TV studio (Room 305) for interviews and discussions with Mike. Additional segmented interviews with other TCT faculty are being arranged throughout the week. Contact for coordination: Josh Hartman Email: jhartman@crf.org Phone: (212) 851-9350 or Booth: 202-249-4505 Saturday, October 11, 2008: 2:00 PM 5:00 PM: ALERT AMI Investigator Meeting in Room 3 at the Renaissance Hotel. 4:00 PM 5:45 PM: Interventional Scientific Council Meeting and Workgroup Breakout Session at the Heart House. Sunday, October 12, 2008: 12:40 PM 1:55 PM: Session Topic: Interventional Strategies and Adjunct Pharmacology in ACS and AMI, Part I: Unstable Angina and NSTEMI. Details: Moderated roundtable discussion and audience Q&A. Location: Room 147 B. Role: Moderator and Panel Moderator. 5:12 PM 5:22 PM: Session Topic: Antiplatelet and Antithrombin Decisions in NSTE-ACS: Data-driven Debates. Details: Lecture on Thienopyridine Decisions: Clopidogrel vs. Prasugrel in NSTE-ACS. Location: Room 147 B. Role: Lecturer. 5:42 PM 5:52 PM: Session Topic: Antiplatelet and Antithrombin Decisions in NSTE-ACS: Data-driven Debates. Details: Roundtable discussion and Q&A with an expert panel and audience. Location: Room 147 B. Role: Discussant. Monday, October 13, 2008: 9:00 AM 10:00 AM: eSCAI meeting. 10:20 AM 10:30 AM: Session Topic: The DES Summit: Dual Anti-Platelet Use Considerations. Details: Lecture on Prasugrel – A Potent Newcomer: Optimizing Use to Reduce Stent Thrombosis Without Increasing Bleeding. Location: Ballroom C. Role: Lecturer. 10:30 AM 10:42 AM: Session Topic: The DES Summit: Dual Anti-Platelet Use Considerations. Details: Discussion with audience Q&A. Location: Ballroom C. Role: Discussant. 3:15 PM 5:30 PM: TCT-TV smaller interviews with the following confirmed participants: G. Dangas: Topic: Interruption of Dual Antiplatelet Therapy. M. Farkouh: Topic: Update on the FREEDOM trial. N. Pijls: Topic: The Treatment of Multivessel Disease (MVD). R. Schwartz: Topic: Integration of Advanced Imaging into Interventional Practice. Fred Feit: Topic: Future of Medical Communications. S-W Park: Topic: Results of the DECREASE-Registry. Z. Hijazi: Topic: Structural Heart Disease – Innovations and Pipeline Developments. M. Krucoff: Topic: Challenges Facing New Drug-Eluting Stents (DES). 5:30 PM 6:30 PM: Interview with Dean Kereiakes on a nuclear substudy of the COURAGE trial. Tuesday, October 14, 2008: 8:30 AM 9:30 AM: Breakfast meeting at the Grand Hyatt. 10:30 AM 11:00 AM: Session Topic: PCI Controversies I. Details: Discussion on the appropriate utilization of antithrombotic and antiplatelet therapies. Location: Ballroom, Third Floor. Role: Discussant. 1:06 PM 1:14 PM: Session Topic: Controversies in Adjunct Pharmacology. Details: Lecture on upstream drug initiation in ACS and its impact on clinical and angiographic outcomes, followed by audience Q&A. Location: Room 201. Role: Lecturer and Case Discussant. 3:05 PM 3:30 PM: Session Topic: ACS Controversies: Adjunct Pharmacology and Conservative vs. Invasive Approach. Details: Roundtable discussion with audience Q&A on the alignment of guidelines with clinical practice and trial results. Location: Room 209 ABC. Role: Discussant. 5:30 PM 6:30 PM: TCT-TV smaller interviews with confirmed participants: Sid Smith: Topic TBD. Gary Mintz: Topic: Advances in ultrasound and its clinical applications. Alice Jacobs: Topic: AHA’s STEMI initiative, Mission: Lifeline. Marty Leon: Topic TBD. Wednesday, October 15, 2008: 8:40 AM 8:55 AM: Session Topic: Focus on Interventional Pharmacology. Details: Lecture on glycoprotein IIb/IIIa inhibitors and their integration into clinical practice. Location: Coronary Theater, Lower Level. Role: Lecturer. 9:00 AM 10:30 AM: Press conference on late-breaking trials, registries, and first-report investigations. Location: Room 159A. Role: Moderator. 12:27 PM 12:30 PM: Session Topic: First Report Randomized Trials & Registries II. Details: Critical commentary on trial results and clinical perspectives. Location: Ballroom, Third Level. Role: Critical Commentator. 2:30 PM 5:30 PM: TCT-TV smaller interviews with confirmed participants: Harvey White: Topic: ACUITY study. Jim Hermiller: Topic: Percutaneous approach to functional mitral regurgitation. Matthew Price: Topic: Clopidogrel non-responsiveness and the GRAVITAS trial. Jeff Popma: Topic: CoreValve Percutaneous Aortic Valve. David Cohen: Topics: Economics of DES, troponin and PCI outcomes, and optimal dual antiplatelet therapy duration. Thursday, October 16, 2008: 9:50 AM 11:05 AM: Session Topic: Antithrombin Alternatives for PCI. Details: Moderated roundtable discussion with audience Q&A. Location: Room 145 AB. Role: Moderator and Panel Moderator. 12:30 PM 1:30 PM: TCT-TV interviews with late-breaking trial presenters. Location: Room 305. Confirmed Participants: C. M. Gibson, D. Hildick-Smith, J. Lassen, R. Byrne. 2:30 PM 5:00 PM: TCT-TV smaller interviews with confirmed participants: Roxana Mehran: Topic: HORIZONS AMI. Gregg Stone: Topic: Drug-eluting stents in AMI. Patrick Serruys: Topic: SYNTAX trial. Carlo Briguori: Topic: Peri-procedural complications in diabetic patients. Interview Coordination: List 1: Suggested interviewees include prominent figures such as Bill Gray, Cindy Grines, Jim Hermiller, Jeff Popma, Matt Price, Deepak Bhatt, and others. List 2: Moderators and presenters of late-breaking trials include Gregg Stone, Marty Leon, Patrick Serruys, Roxana Mehran, and others.
